full_prompt_en: A square botanical watercolor shows a cluster of pink and white roses with leaves and buds against a pale warm cream background. The flower group rises from the lower center and leans upward toward the right, leaving quiet blank paper around its outer edges. A large blush-pink bloom dominates the left middle area. Its many curled petals shift from cool rose in the shaded center to almost white along the lit outer rims. Above and to the right, a pale white rose opens in layered translucent folds, with a small golden center partly visible. Several tight dark red buds stand among slender stems near the upper middle, while a small spray of yellow flowers appears behind the larger blooms on the left. Broad blue-green leaves spread across the lower right and lower left, their veins and serrated edges drawn with close observation. Some leaves overlap into deep green shadow; others catch cool pale light along their central ribs. Thin brown-green stems remain visible through gaps in the foliage, connecting the flowers without forming a heavy outline. The cream ground contains little setting or cast shadow, presenting the arrangement as an isolated study. Watercolor washes build gentle petal translucency, and finer dark strokes clarify folds, veins, and bud edges. Light seems to arrive softly from the upper left, brightening petal rims while leaving deeper creases and leaf undersides shaded. The composition is detailed but airy: dense overlapping forms gather around the center while plenty of pale paper remains at the corners. No writing or labeling is visible. The overall image is delicate and exacting, using restrained color changes and botanical precision to make the flowers feel both natural and carefully arranged.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形植物学水彩画呈现一簇粉色和白色玫瑰、叶片与花苞，背景是浅暖奶油色。花丛从下方中央升起并向右上倾斜，外围留下安静空白纸面。左中部一朵大的浅粉花占主导。层层卷曲花瓣从阴影中心的冷玫瑰色过渡到受光外缘近乎白色。上方偏右，一朵浅白玫瑰以半透明的层叠褶瓣展开，局部露出小小金色花心。几枚紧合的深红花苞立在上方中部的细茎之间，左侧大花后方则有一小簇黄色花朵。宽大的蓝绿叶片铺向右下与左下，叶脉和锯齿边缘得到细致观察。有些叶片相互遮挡，沉入深绿阴影；另一些沿中央叶筋接住冷淡浅光。细棕绿色茎秆从叶间空隙露出，连接花朵，却不形成沉重外轮廓。奶油色底域少有环境或投影，使花束以独立研究对象呈现。水彩晕染建立温和的花瓣透明感，更细的深色笔痕明确褶皱、叶脉和花苞边缘。光似乎从左上方柔和照来，提亮花瓣外缘，让更深的折缝和叶片背面保持阴影。构图细致却通透：密集重叠形体聚在中心，四角仍保留大量浅纸。没有可见文字或标签。整体画面纤细而严谨，用克制的色彩变化和植物学精度使花朵既自然又经过认真安排。
style_prompt_en: The botanical watercolor style rests on pale open paper, transparent layered washes, and exact small linework. Soft tonal shifts model rounded folds without heavy outlines, while sharper strokes select veins, serrations, and inner recesses. Cool blue-green masses support blush pink, off-white, muted red, and small ochre accents. Dense overlapping forms gather in one area, but generous negative space keeps the arrangement light. Pigment pools gently along a few edges and thins toward luminous highlights, retaining the medium's watery character. Diffuse upper-side light gives raised planes delicate brightness and leaves folds in quiet shadow. The overall effect is precise and graceful, joining naturalistic observation to an airy, carefully balanced page composition.
style_prompt_zh: 这种植物学水彩风格建立在浅亮开放纸面、透明叠染和精确小线条之上。柔和调子变化无需沉重轮廓就能塑造圆转褶面，更锐的笔痕则挑出叶脉、锯齿和内部凹处。冷蓝绿体量支撑浅粉、灰白、暗红及小块赭黄。密集互叠形体聚于一处，宽裕留白仍让安排显得轻盈。颜料在少数边缘温和积聚，朝发亮高光处逐渐变薄，保留水性媒介特点。偏上侧漫射光给隆起平面纤细亮度，让折缝保持安静阴影。整体效果精确而优雅，把自然主义观察与通透、审慎均衡的纸面构图结合。
theme_en: A botanical study of pink and white roses with blue-green leaves
theme_zh: 粉白玫瑰与蓝绿色叶片的植物学研究图
name: Pierre-Joseph Redoute
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
